note: Mark-scheme flag on every question; the teacher-only exam paper uses only questions with an official mark scheme and names each source only in its mark scheme.
changes: Every question in the Papers bank now carries an internal mark-scheme flag derived from its data: official (444 past-paper questions with their paired Edexcel schemes), worked solutions only (8,622 practice, exam-style and skill questions) or none.

The teacher-only exam paper (manual selection and timed generation) includes only questions with an official mark scheme; the panel shows how many of the chosen questions qualify, and a question without one is labelled and must be removed before printing.
Exam question pages show no source; the mark scheme section names each question's exact source and bank ID so any issue can be traced.
Practice, exam-style and past-paper printouts outside the exam paper are unchanged.
reportIntro: Luisa v0.74 makes the teacher-only exam paper rely only on genuine mark schemes. Every question now records whether an official mark scheme exists; today that is the 444 past-paper questions, and the exam builder (manual and timed) uses only those. Practice and exam-style questions keep their worked solutions everywhere else.
Exam question pages no longer reveal where a question came from, while the mark scheme names each question's exact source and bank ID for tracing. PMT Core Pure questions follow in v0.75 and v0.76.
changelog: Papers: internal `markScheme` flag (official | source | worked | none) on every catalogue row, derived by `scripts/mark_schemes.py` and checked in the gate; counts per source on #135 (444 official, 8,622 worked, 0 none).

Exam paper: only questions with an official (or source) mark scheme in manual selection, timed generation and every print option; the panel shows the eligible count; a flag-false question is labelled "No mark scheme" and blocks Preview.
Exam paper: no source on the front page or question pages; each scheme entry shows "Source: … · ID …".
roadmap: [Issue #135](https://github.com/vyr66mbzmh-debug/Luisa/issues/135) adds a derived mark-scheme flag to every question. The teacher-only exam paper uses only questions with an official mark scheme, hides sources on question pages and names them in the scheme (PAP-074-1 to PAP-074-4). PMT Core Pure 1 and 2 follow in v0.75 and v0.76.
